description: Repair the system repository gym-local so both versions of gym-workload are available and package and repository signatures are verified using the provided public key. Enable the repository.
hint: Review dnf.conf(5), repository metadata and GPG verification.
setup:
mkdir -p /opt/gym-repo; cp -a {fixture}/. /opt/gym-repo/; printf '[gym-local]
name=Gym local
baseurl=file:///opt/gym-missing
enabled=0
gpgcheck=0
repo_gpgcheck=0
gpgkey=file:///opt/gym-repo/KEY.asc
' > /etc/yum.repos.d/gym-local.repo; dnf clean all
checks: python3 -c 'import configparser; c=configparser.ConfigParser(); c.read("/etc/yum.repos.d/gym-local.repo"); s=c["gym-local"]; assert s.getboolean("gpgcheck") and s.getboolean("repo_gpgcheck") and s["gpgkey"]=="file:///opt/gym-repo/KEY.asc"'

description: Install version 1.0-1 of gym-workload from the signed RPM located in /opt/gym-repo. The package must be installed in the system RPM database.
hint: Review rpm and dnf package installation.
setup: mkdir -p /opt/gym-repo; cp -a {fixture}/. /opt/gym-repo/; rpm -e gym-workload 2>/dev/null || true; rpm --import /opt/gym-repo/KEY.asc

description: Upgrade the installed gym-workload package to version 2.0-1 using the signed package available under /opt/gym-repo.
hint: Review rpm and dnf upgrade operations.
setup: mkdir -p /opt/gym-repo; cp -a {fixture}/. /opt/gym-repo/; rpm -e gym-workload 2>/dev/null || true; rpm --import /opt/gym-repo/KEY.asc; rpm -i /opt/gym-repo/gym-workload-1.0-1.noarch.rpm

description: Configure the system-wide Flatpak remote flathub using its official repository definition, and install the application org.gnome.Calculator for all users.
Configure the kernel argument audit=1 for all installed kernel boot entries. The running kernel must use it after a reboot.
hint: Review grubby and kernel command-line options.
